_comment: Exemptions for scripts/check-translation-keys.mjs. A trailing * matches a prefix.
missing: features that legitimately ship ahead of translation. Every entry should be
temporary. If a feature sits here for months its copy is reaching non-English users in
English, which is the exact problem this check exists to surface. Prefer deleting
dead: DB keys the frontend does not request from JSX. Most of these are NOT dead - they
are config-driven labels delivered by the API and turned into FormattedMessage at
runtime by src/Components/Config/configHook.tsx, so a static AST walk cannot see them.
See the 'Config-driven labels' note in the script header.
english: values correctly identical to English - proper nouns, programme acronyms.
